description.value: A small 11-site provincial campground on Nancy Greene Lake near Rossland in the Kootenays, with washrooms and potable water; the gate closes in the off-season, limiting this to a summer stop.

address.value: 3 Crowsnest Hwy, Robson, BC V1N 4V8, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website (env.gov.bc.ca) confirms Nancy Greene Park is a real, active provincial park in the BC Parks system — the page loaded successfully and includes a prominent 'Book camping' link and a Reservations section, supporting that reservations are accepted. OSM supplies key details: 10 parking-lot-style sites, fee required, internet_access=no, and operator Quality Recreation Ltd. The website's content block is primarily navigation text and does not provide facility-level amenity details for this specific campground, so most amenities remain null.
concerns: OSM email (info@explorebcparks.ca) appears to belong to operator Quality Recreation Ltd., not BC Parks directly — may be a secondary contact rather than the primary park contact.
Website content retrieved is mostly top-level navigation; no facility-level amenity details for Nancy Greene specifically were available, leaving most amenities unverifiable.
All probed subpages (/about/, /about/news/, etc.) returned 404; these are generic BC Parks subpaths and do not indicate the park page itself is broken.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active BC Parks provincial campground with a working booking system; a legitimate overnight option for touring cyclists in the Kootenays.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM capacity tag reads '10 parking lot style sites', suggesting standard drive-in sites rather than walk-in hiker/biker sites, but this is not confirmed from the website.
